'''Zero Squad''' was a cold-weather unit of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Galactic War]] they were stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where they suffered an attack by the Imperial forces.

==Behind the scenes==
Zero Squad appeared in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]] in the Imperial faction mission Fire in the Hole on Hoth. In spoken dialogue, the unit is referred to as Zero Squad, but in the written mission log, the unit is referred to as Zero Team.<ref name="FitH" />
